title: Holes and Slots in Metal Bone Plates, Part 4: Corresponding to Screws with Symmetrical Thread and Conical Undersurfaces
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 11567 (PART 4)) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Holes and Slots in Metal Bone Plates, Part 4: Corresponding to Screws with Symmetrical Thread and Conical Undersurfaces.
clause_3_terminology: Holes and Slots in Metal Bone Plates
Part 4: Corresponding to Screws with Symmetrical Thread and Conical Undersurfaces
Holes and Slots in Metal Bone Plates, Part 4: Corresponding to Screws with Symmetrical Thread and Conical Undersurfaces

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
